launch_readiness.reason: Local contract tests and static visual evidence pass, but the repository does not yet contain a deployable production application or live environment evidence.

launch_blockers.issue: The current web, worker, persistence, scraper, and integration code is a contract/static-preview scaffold rather than a deployable production runtime.
launch_blockers.required_action: Return implementation to Stage 6 and build executable Next.js routes/actions, worker runtime wiring, persistence repositories, production scraper/PDF integrations, authentication middleware, and deployable service entrypoints.
launch_blockers.launch_impact: No production deployment, end-to-end smoke test, hosted health check, or real-user launch is possible.

launch_blockers.issue: Stage 6 declares readiness without a Stage 6 global readiness audit and its durable Implementation-state remains in progress.
launch_blockers.required_action: Complete the Stage 6 state, handoff contract, schema/reference checks, and Stage-6-readiness-audit after the production runtime work is complete.
launch_blockers.launch_impact: The sequential stage transition is not auditable.

launch_blockers.issue: Production environment ownership, credentials, secret values, hosted endpoints, alert routing, and release approver are not verified.
launch_blockers.required_action: After a deployable runtime exists, provision and verify Vercel, Fly.io, Neon, Upstash, object storage, authentication, provider, and Sentry configuration without recording secret values in the repository.
launch_blockers.launch_impact: Deployment, monitoring, rollback, and incident-response proof cannot be collected.

readiness_gates.name: deployment_readiness
readiness_gates.next_action: Produce deployable web and worker artifacts, then perform a target-environment dry run.

readiness_gates.name: environment_readiness
readiness_gates.next_action: Name the release owner and verify staging and production service ownership.

readiness_gates.name: secret_readiness
readiness_gates.next_action: Verify required secret names and platform injection; never write secret values to source control.

readiness_gates.name: data_migration_readiness
blockers: No versioned production migration artifact or rehearsal exists.
readiness_gates.next_action: Create versioned migrations and rehearse forward-fix/rollback against staging data.

readiness_gates.name: validation_evidence_readiness
blockers: Validation covers contracts and static previews, not deployed end-to-end behavior.
readiness_gates.next_action: Run deployed authentication, import, queue, persistence, storage, AI fallback, and tenant-isolation tests.

readiness_gates.name: visual_qa_readiness
readiness_gates.next_action: Repeat visual QA against the deployed runtime before private alpha.

readiness_gates.name: design_system_readiness
readiness_gates.next_action: Preserve the recorded design-system references in the production UI.

readiness_gates.name: monitoring_readiness
blockers: No live Sentry project, hosted probes, tested alerts, or routing owner is recorded.
readiness_gates.next_action: Wire observability and execute one synthetic alert per critical signal.

readiness_gates.name: analytics_readiness
blockers: The event instrumentation and dashboard data source are not implemented.
readiness_gates.next_action: Implement the Stage 7 event catalog and validate tenant-safe event capture.

readiness_gates.name: rollback_readiness
blockers: Rollback passed only as a Stage 6 paper dry run; no real environment rehearsal exists.
readiness_gates.next_action: Rehearse web, worker, queue, provider, and database recovery in staging.

readiness_gates.name: support_readiness
blockers: Support owner, intake channel, response targets, and escalation contact are unassigned.
readiness_gates.next_action: Assign support ownership and test the four launch-critical support scenarios.

readiness_gates.name: onboarding_readiness
blockers: No private-alpha onboarding checklist or tenant setup verification is recorded.
readiness_gates.next_action: Create and test workspace, credential, provider, first-import, and recovery onboarding.

readiness_gates.name: known_risk_acceptance
blockers: No Stage 7 launch risk has an explicit approver, expiry/review date, or production evidence.
readiness_gates.next_action: Record only deliberately accepted launch risks after evidence review; do not accept missing runtime implementation as risk.

onboarding_gaps: Manual fallback and stuck-job recovery guidance

assumptions.assumption: The Stage 5 platform direction remains Vercel, Fly.io, Neon, and Upstash.
assumptions.next_action: Release owner confirms or revises the target platform before provisioning.

risks.risk: Contract-level validation may overstate production readiness.
risks.mitigation: Complete executable runtime implementation and deployed end-to-end validation.
